title: ExplorerUsageLink
responsibility: Opens a consumer entity and previews its own revision-bound screenshot on hover or keyboard focus.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsageLink.entity
inputs.description: Referenced entity at the shown revision; its own capture is used.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsageLink.nav
inputs.description: Navigation preserving the selected branch and commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsageLink.lens
inputs.description: The selected revision evidence resolver; no screenshot is borrowed from another entity.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsageLink.mediaBase
inputs.description: URL prefix resolving the referenced screenshot file.

outputs.name: ExplorerUsageLink
outputs.description: A consumer link or source button with a hover or keyboard preview. Visual-card previews stay inside all four card edges, in the larger clear area above or below the title; other previews stay within their owner width and viewport.

errors.name: nav.href callback error
errors.description: An error from the address callback propagates while rendering an entity link.

errors.name: nav.go callback error
errors.description: An error from the navigation callback propagates when a link is activated.

errors.name: nav.source callback error
errors.description: An error from the source-opening callback propagates when its button is activated.

errors.name: lens.evidence callback error
errors.description: An error from the evidence callback propagates when a visual consumer preview opens.
